userDescription: Governed sales orders semantic model containing SalesOrders with Amount, CustomerName, OrderDate, and OrderId.
dataSourceInstructions:
## General knowledge
Use the SalesOrders table for all sales, order, customer, amount, total, ranking, and trend questions.

## Table descriptions
SalesOrders contains OrderId, CustomerName, OrderDate, and Amount. Amount is the sales amount column. There is no TotalAmount column.

## When asked about
For total sales, generate read-only DAX equivalent to SUM(SalesOrders[Amount]). For order count, use COUNTROWS(SalesOrders). Generate DAX for this semantic model, never SQL. Never invent values.

children.description: Sales amount. Sum this column for total sales.
